SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_details WHERE order_status = '대기') AS waitingCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_details WHERE order_status = '승인') AS approvedCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_details WHERE order_status = '거절') AS rejectedCount

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, od.order_detail_id AS orderDetailId, od.order_status AS orderStatus
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
ORDER BY o.order_id

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, s.store_name AS storeName, MIN(i.ingredient_name) AS firstIngredientName, COUNT(DISTINCT od.ingredient_id) AS ingredientCount, o.total_price AS totalPrice, MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
AND o.order_at >= #{startDate}
AND o.order_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND od.order_status = #{orderStatus}
AND s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{storeName}, '%')
AND o.order_id = #{orderId}
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.total_price
ORDER BY o.order_at DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, s.store_name AS storeName, od.order_status AS orderStatus, o.app_at AS appAt, od.store_at AS storeAt, o.total_price AS totalPrice, u.user_name AS userName FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id JOIN users u ON o.user_id=u.user_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.total_price

SELECT i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, od.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit, od.supply_price AS supplyPrice, od.order_price AS orderPrice, od.order_status AS orderStatus, od.reject_reason AS rejectReason
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
ORDER BY od.ingredient_id
SELECT ingredient_name AS ingredientName, supply_price AS supplyPrice, supply_quantity AS supplyQuantity FROM ingredients ORDER BY ingredient_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_details ( order_quantity, supply_price, manufacture_at, store_at , app_at, order_status, order_price, reject_reason, current_quantity, order_id, ingredient_id ) VALUES ( #{orderQuantity}, #{supplyPrice}, NULL, NULL, NULL, '대기', #{orderPrice}, NULL, 0, #{orderId}, #{ingredientId} )

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, o.total_price AS totalPrice, MAX(od.order_status) AS orderStatus, MAX(od.app_at) AS appAt, MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId}
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, o.total_price

SELECT i.ingredient_name, od.order_quantity, i.order_unit, od.supply_price, od.order_price, u.user_name FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId}
